Explore precinct-by-precinct results from the November 3, 2026 general elections across multiple states.

## North Carolina — U.S. Senate

Hover over any precinct to inspect vote totals for **Roy Cooper (DEM)** and **Michael Whatley (REP)**, or use the top-right toggle to switch between **Vote Margin** and **Total Votes Cast**.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(mapgl)

# Read November 3, 2026 general election results for real geographic precincts
senate_pct <- read_tsv("data/north-carolina/results_pct_20261103.txt", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US SENATE", `Real Precinct` == "Y") |>
  summarise(
    total_votes = sum(`Total Votes`),
    cooper_votes = sum(`Total Votes`[Choice == "Roy Cooper"]),
    whatley_votes = sum(`Total Votes`[Choice == "Michael Whatley"]),
    other_votes = sum(`Total Votes`[!Choice %in% c("Roy Cooper", "Michael Whatley")]),
    winner = Choice[which.max(`Total Votes`)],
    .by = c(County, Precinct)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    cooper_pct = if_else(total_votes > 0, round(100 * cooper_votes / total_votes, 1), NA_real_),
    whatley_pct = if_else(total_votes > 0, round(100 * whatley_votes / total_votes, 1), NA_real_),
    dem_margin = if_else(total_votes > 0, round(100 * (cooper_votes - whatley_votes) / total_votes, 1), NA_real_),
    margin_label = case_when(
      is.na(dem_margin) ~ "No votes reported",
      dem_margin > 0 ~ paste0("Cooper +", dem_margin, "%"),
      dem_margin < 0 ~ paste0("Whatley +", abs(dem_margin), "%"),
      TRUE ~ "Tied (0.0%)"
    )
  )

# Read, simplify, and reproject Aug 2026 NC precinct boundaries to WGS84
precincts_sf <- st_read("data/north-carolina/precincts/SBE_PRECINCTS_20260824.shp", quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 250, preserveTopology = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  left_join(senate_pct, by = c("county_nam" = "County", "prec_id" = "Precinct")) |>
  mutate(
    hover_tip = paste0(
      "<strong>", enr_desc, "</strong> (", county_nam, " County)<br>",
      "Margin: <strong>", coalesce(margin_label, "No votes"), "</strong><br>",
      "Roy Cooper (DEM): ", coalesce(as.character(cooper_pct), "0"), "% (", scales::comma(coalesce(cooper_votes, 0)), ")<br>",
      "Michael Whatley (REP): ", coalesce(as.character(whatley_pct), "0"), "% (", scales::comma(coalesce(whatley_votes, 0)), ")<br>",
      "Third-Party Votes: ", scales::comma(coalesce(other_votes, 0)), "<br>",
      "Total Precinct Votes: ", scales::comma(coalesce(total_votes, 0))
    )
  )

# Diverging red-white-blue scale for Cooper vs. Whatley margin
margin_pal <- interpolate_palette(
  data = precincts_sf,
  column = "dem_margin",
  data_values = c(-60, -30, 0, 30, 60),
  colors = c("#b2182b", "#ef8a62", "#f7f7f7", "#67a9cf", "#2166ac"),
  na_color = "#d9d9d9"
)

# Sequential purple scale for precinct vote volume
volume_pal <- interpolate_palette(
  data = precincts_sf,
  column = "total_votes",
  data_values = c(250, 750, 1500, 2500, 4000),
  colors = c("#edf8fb", "#b3cde3", "#8c96c6", "#8856a7", "#4d004b"),
  na_color = "#d9d9d9"
)

# Build interactive MapLibre precinct map
maplibre(
  style = carto_style("positron"),
  bounds = precincts_sf,
  height = "680px"
) |>
  add_source(id = "nc_precincts", data = precincts_sf) |>
  add_fill_layer(
    id = "Vote Margin (DEM - REP)",
    source = "nc_precincts",
    fill_color = margin_pal$expression,
    fill_opacity = 0.84,
    fill_outline_color = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)",
    tooltip = "hover_tip",
    hover_options = list(fill_opacity = 1, fill_outline_color = "#111111")
  ) |>
  add_fill_layer(
    id = "Total Votes Cast",
    source = "nc_precincts",
    visibility = "none",
    fill_color = volume_pal$expression,
    fill_opacity = 0.84,
    fill_outline_color = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)",
    tooltip = "hover_tip",
    hover_options = list(fill_opacity = 1, fill_outline_color = "#111111")
  ) |>
  add_legend(
    legend_title = "U.S. Senate Margin",
    values = c("Whatley +60%", "Whatley +30%", "Even", "Cooper +30%", "Cooper +60%"),
    colors = margin_pal$colors,
    type = "continuous",
    position = "bottom-left",
    layer_id = "Vote Margin (DEM - REP)",
    add = TRUE
  ) |>
  add_legend(
    legend_title = "Total Precinct Votes",
    values = c("250", "750", "1,500", "2,500", "4,000+"),
    colors = volume_pal$colors,
    type = "continuous",
    position = "bottom-left",
    layer_id = "Total Votes Cast",
    add = TRUE
  ) |>
  add_layers_control(
    position = "top-right",
    layers = c("Vote Margin (DEM - REP)", "Total Votes Cast"),
    collapsible = FALSE,
    mode = "single"
  )
```
